name: Blades
desc: The 2008 console dashboard, in Greenhouse green.
_note: The 2008 dashboard, in Greenhouse's green rather than its blue. Ported from
the nxe design mockup. Square, hairline-separated, with the page's
navigation standing in a column down the left -- which is why this theme
selects the `blades` layout and not `list`: the shape IS the theme.
Titillium Web is the mockup's face and is not on the console; the chain ends
at Segoe UI, which is the one family this device reliably has.
